headline: Granite Systems wins quality award from industry association
body: Granite Systems received a supplier excellence award citing low defect rates and strong on-time delivery. The company plans to publish its audit results later this year.

headline: Granite Systems opens new production line in Leipzig
body: Granite Systems commissioned a new line at its Leipzig site, adding capacity for existing customers. Management said the expansion was funded from operating cash flow.

headline: Granite Systems faces customer complaints over packaging defects
body: Several customers reported damaged goods linked to packaging changes at Granite Systems. The company said it is reviewing its packing process.

headline: Granite Systems reports record quarterly revenue
body: Granite Systems reported revenue growth of 12% year over year, driven by repeat orders. Analysts described the results as ahead of expectations.

headline: Granite Systems signs multi-year framework agreement
body: Granite Systems announced a framework agreement with a large manufacturer. Terms were not disclosed, and the company expects stable volumes through the contract period.
